transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Well... I guess I just don't have the push I used to have. For things like choir, or my quilting. I don't really visit folks anymore. Most days I just... sit at the house. Keep the TV on low. I know people are expecting me, but... I just don't go.
Have you felt this way for most of the time for at least two years?
I suppose... yes. It's just been building up for a while now. Ever since I retired from the school office... that was a little over two years ago.
During this time, have there been periods of at least two weeks when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?
I don't... I don't think so. Not depressed, exactly. Just... quiet, I guess.
Have you ever been told you have a medical illness that affects your brain or body, such as stroke, Parkinson’s disease, thyroid disease, or another major condition?
No, I haven't. Just the usual aches and pains, I suppose. Nothing like that.
Have you had a time when you felt depressed or down most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks?
No... I think I just said, I wouldn't really call it depressed. I don't feel sad or down like that... I just mostly keep to myself.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy?

I suppose... I just don't have the push I used to have. For choir, or quilting. Visiting folks. Most days I just sit at home... keep the TV on low. Even when I know people are expecting me, I just... don't go.
During this time, have you often felt sad or depressed?
I... no. I think I already told you that. I just... I don't feel sad. I just don't feel much of anything, really.
Do you often feel bad about yourself or like you’re a failure?
No, I... I don't think so. I just... I don't really think about it like that.
How has your sleep been during this time?
It's... fine. I sleep alright, I guess. Just normal.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight?
No... I don't think so. I just eat what I usually do. Nothing's really changed.
Have you had any trouble concentrating or making decisions during this time?
Not really... I just do what I always do. It's... it's fine, I guess.
Have you felt sad, down, or depressed most of the day nearly every day during any period of at least two weeks?
No... not really. I'm just... regular. I don't get sad like that.
Has there ever been a time when you felt down or depressed most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks?
I think you just asked me that... but no. I don't get down like that. I never had a time like that. Just... regular days.
Do you often feel hopeless?
No. I don't... I don't really think about things like that. I'm fine.
Do you often feel worthless?
No... I don't. I'm just... I'm just me. I don't feel that way.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when you lost interest or pleasure in almost everything?
No... I don't think so. I still... do the things I usually do. It's just normal.
Have you often felt low on energy?
No... not really. I have enough to get by. I just... do my normal things.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed or down most of the day nearly every day?
No... I don't get like that. I just... wake up and do what I always do. It's the same.
Would you say your mood is usually low or gloomy most days?
No. I wouldn't say that. It's just... normal. Nothing special about it.
